title: Control backlog scribble: attestation prep
content:
Quick scratch + backlog for attestation readiness — messy, forgive the fragments.

Context:
- Running SOC2-lite prep for hosted + dedicated products. Need tighter evidence for change control, access reviews, and deployment isolation for private.
- Goal: have minimal artifact set that satisfies auditor checklist and scripts for export.

Open questions (prioritize):
1) Which deployment pipelines currently have signed PR approval artifacts stored centrally? (infra + release-engineering) — I think only k8s-ops has archived approvals right now. Ticket JIRA-TRUST-1027 to track.
2) Access review cadence: monthly for SRE/infra? Quarterly for product teams? Align w/ HR offboarding events.
3) Crypto key rotation evidence: where are KMS rotation logs kept for private customers (on-prem vs cloud)? Need sample from last 90 days.

Control mapping notes (draft):
- Change control (CC-01): map to repo PR approvals (CODEOWNERS + signed-off) + release notes + deployment runbook. Evidence: PR diff, approval timeline, release artifact (tag).
- Access provisioning (AC-03): map to Okta group membership export + last activity + HR termination report. Evidence: okta-export-YYYYMM.csv, offboard tickets.
- Data segregation (DS-07): for private deployments map to VPC config snapshots + network diagrams + customer contract excerpt. Evidence: vpc-snapshot-<customer>-2025-11.json (example).

Immediate TODOs (alpha runbook):
- [ ] Export last 6 months of PR approvals for core infra repos (assign: Ravi)
- [ ] Pull Okta group membership snapshot (assign: Priya)
- [ ] Find 2 samples of KMS rotation logs for private customers (assign: Elodie)
- [ ] Draft evidence index spreadsheet + column guidance: control_id, evidence_type, owner, path, retention.

Risk scoring heuristics (sketch):
- Likelihood: 1-5 (1=rare, 5=frequent) — use last 12 months ops incidents as baseline.
- Impact: 1-5 (1=minor, 5=service affecting / legal).
- Quick calc: risk = likelihood * impact, color-code >12 red.

Notes on artifacts & export:
- Avoid manual screenshots where possible — auditors want primary logs. If only UI is available, capture export + why primary missing.
- Provide a short script to fetch evidence (curl/gh/jq) and place into zip with manifest.json listing checksums.

Edge cases to flag:
- Legacy CI (circleci -> replaced) — some approvals live in old CI; we need to surface via archive.
- External contractors with service accounts — verify last active and whether MFA enforced.

Draft messaging to teams (for later):
"Short ask: we need 1–2 primary artifacts for X control by Mar 15. Please add to /trust-evidence/<control-id>/<team-name>/"

Quick sketch of evidence index columns (text table):
control_id | evidence_type | file_path | owner | period | note
CC-01     | PR-approval   | /trust-evidence/CC-01/infra-prs.zip | ravi.shah | 2025-09..2026-02 | includes CODEOWNERS check
AC-03     | okta-export   | /trust-evidence/AC-03/okta-2026-02.csv  | priya.nair | 2026-02 | needs mapping to HR ids

Slack refs / convo pointers:
- ping @ravi in #trust-ops for infra exports (thread linked above).
- had a quick sync w/ Priya 2026-02-18 — she flagged access export rate limits. Might need paging.

Loose ideas for automation (future):
- Lambda / small cron job that packs last-n artifacts for each control into dated zip and posts to internal S3 with limited retention + immutable flag for audit sampling.
- Small GH Action in infra repos that writes a 'control-evidence' file on tag release (simple JSON with PR id, approvers, timestamp).

End-of-file: rough, will iterate after Ravi's export and Priya's okta snapshot.

-- elodie (notes to self)

Unresolved TODOs to triage week of Mar 1:
- Get signoff from release-engineering on whether release tags are sufficient evidence for CC-01.
- Confirm retention policy for evidence zips (legal to weigh in).

Scratch: random ticket refs to keep: JIRA-TRUST-1027 (change control), JIRA-TRUST-1103 (okta export), JIRA-TRUST-1110 (kms logs).
